title: Add --check mode to schc_parity gen_vectors.py and wire it as step 0 of check-schc-compression-parity.py (freshness guard for the committed header)
description: Found by all three review passes of project-LICHEN-worker6-0w1g (P2 follow-up; prerequisite satisfied by 0w1g which fixed the generator banner so regen output is byte-identical to the committed header). Since 0w1g, lichen/tests/schc_parity/schc_parity_vectors.h is a committed artifact (no CMake build-dir generation). Blind spot: editing test/vectors/schc_compression.json WITHOUT regenerating the header leaves all three parity legs green (python reads JSON directly, rust reads JSON directly, C compiles the stale committed header) - C silently tests a stale corpus; scripts/check-schc-compression-parity.py:36-77 has no freshness check and .github workflows reference neither gen_vectors nor schc_parity. Fix: (1) add --check mode to lichen/tests/schc_parity/gen_vectors.py - generate to memory, byte-compare against the on-disk header, exit nonzero on drift (bounded reads mirroring test/vectors/atomic_json.py read_bounded_exact style); (2) invoke it as step 0 of scripts/check-schc-compression-parity.py before the three legs; (3) optionally also guard other suites with configure-time generators the same way (schc_ack_processing, schc_reassembly, schc_fragment_generation, routing_dispatch, regional_duty_cycle, drift_bound, asn_sfn, coap_codec all still generate into build dirs - lower priority since their headers are not committed artifacts).
